name: Kessil A360X Tuna Sun
description: Compact freshwater pendant with Kessil's Dense Matrix LED: a single point source that throws strong shimmer lines, tunable across a published 6,000-9,000K range. light.colorTempK records the mid-point (7500) of that range. Kessil publishes PAR and coverage area rather than luminous flux, so light.lumens is omitted rather than estimated. light.beamAngleDeg is the published 130-degree reflector spread; light.fixtureLengthMm is the published 110 mm puck diameter (the fixture is round, not a bar). coverageLitres is omitted: Kessil publishes a 60 x 60 cm footprint for densely planted systems, not a tank-volume window.
